title: Outdoor Picnic Gathering, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo, 1949
description: A vintage black and white snapshot taken on July 26, 1949, capturing a group of young adults and women gathered around a wooden picnic table under the shade of large trees. The women are wearing classic late-1940s short-sleeved tops, skirts, and styled period haircuts while sharing a summer meal outdoors, reflecting post-WWII American leisure and social traditions.
